pages.text: $(italic)No tradeoffs and no standout strengths. The Human is the most flexible race: every class and playstyle is equally viable.$()$(br2)$(bold)Versatile$(): +1 bonus to whichever skill tree you invest in most (checked every 30 min), which rewards focused builds.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Quick Learner$(): +15% XP from all sources, which compounds a lot over long play sessions.$(br2)$(bold)Adaptable$(): change your secondary race trait at a Class Altar once every 24 IRL hours (a minor toggle only).$(br2)$(bold)Next: pair it with any class, or Wanderer if you're undecided: $(l:icraft:welcome/class_guide)Origin, Race & Class$(/l).$()
